"__prisma_data__" FROM "public"."classes" AS "t6" LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('id', "t7"."id", 'code', "t7"."code", 'name', "t7"."name", 'facultyId', "t7"."faculty_id", 'faculty', "Major_faculty"."__prisma_data__") AS "__prisma_data__" FROM "public"."majors" AS "t7" LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('id', "t8"."id", 'code', "t8"."code", 'name', "t8"."name") AS "__prisma_data__" FROM "public"."faculties" AS "t8" WHERE "t7"."faculty_id" = "t8"."id" LIMIT $1) AS "Major_faculty" ON true WHERE "t6"."major_id" = "t7"."id" LIMIT $2) AS "Class_major" ON true WHERE "t3"."class_id" = "t6"."id" LIMIT $3) AS "ClassStudent_class" ON true /* inner select */) AS "t4" ORDER BY "t4"."enrolled_at" DESC LIMIT $4 /* middle select */) AS "t5" /* outer select */) AS "User_classStudents" ON true WHERE ("t0"."role" = CAST($5::text AS "public"."UserRole") AND "t0"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND ("t0"."username" ILIKE ('%' || $6 || '%') OR "t0"."email" ILIKE ('%' || $7 || '%') OR "t0"."full_name" ILIKE ('%' || $8 || '%') OR "t0"."phone" ILIKE ('%' || $9 || '%') OR EXISTS(SELECT "t1"."student_id" FROM "public"."class_students" AS "t1" WHERE ("t1"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "t1"."student_code" ILIKE ('%' || $10 || '%') AND ("t0"."id") = ("t1"."student_id") AND "t1"."student_id" IS NOT NULL)))) ORDER BY "t0"."created_at" DESC, "t0"."id" DESC LIMIT $11 OFFSET $12

"t0"."student_score" AS "studentScore", "t0"."class_score" AS "classScore", "t0"."final_score" AS "finalScore", "t0"."rank"::text, "t0"."student_id" AS "studentId", "EvaluationForm_semester"."__prisma_data__" AS "semester" FROM "public"."evaluation_forms" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "public"."classes" AS "orderby_1" ON ("orderby_1"."id") = ("t0"."class_id") LEFT JOIN "public"."users" AS "orderby_2" ON ("orderby_2"."id") = ("t0"."student_id") LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('id', "t1"."id", 'fullName', "t1"."full_name", 'email', "t1"."email") AS "__prisma_data__" FROM "public"."users" AS "t1" WHERE "t0"."student_id" = "t1"."id" LIMIT $1) AS "EvaluationForm_student" ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('id', "t2"."id", 'code', "t2"."code", 'name', "t2"."name", 'majorId', "t2"."major_id", 'major', "Class_major"."__prisma_data__") AS "__prisma_data__" FROM "public"."classes" AS "t2" LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('facultyId', "t3"."faculty_id", 'faculty', "Major_faculty"."__prisma_data__") AS "__prisma_data__" FROM "public"."majors" AS "t3" LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('id', "t4"."id", 'code', "t4"."code", 'name', "t4"."name") AS "__prisma_data__" FROM "public"."faculties" AS "t4" WHERE "t3"."faculty_id" = "t4"."id" LIMIT $2) AS "Major_faculty" ON true WHERE "t2"."major_id" = "t3"."id" LIMIT $3) AS "Class_major" ON true WHERE "t0"."class_id" = "t2"."id" LIMIT $4) AS "EvaluationForm_class" ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('year', "t5"."year", 'semester', "t5"."semester", 'isActive', "t5"."is_active", 'studentDeadline', "t5"."student_deadline", 'classDeadline', "t5"."class_deadline", 'facultyDeadline', "t5"."faculty_deadline") AS "__prisma_data__" FROM "public"."semesters" AS "t5" WHERE "t0"."semester_id" = "t5"."id" LIMIT $5) AS "EvaluationForm_semester" ON true WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY "orderby_1"."name" ASC, "orderby_2"."full_name" ASC LIMIT $6
